about_the_game:
The expansion introduces three new missions where players will face off against enemies controlled by artificial intelligence.
Each mission offers unique challenges and objectives that require strategy and skill to overcome.
Players will need to rely on their abilities to succeed in intense battles.
Get ready for an exciting fight against bots in single-player mode!
